commands.command:
mkdir release-artifact release-artifact/release
aws s3 cp "s3://${AWS_RELEASES_BUCKET}/releases/${RELEASE_SHA}/site.tar.gz" release-artifact/<site-project>-site-${RELEASE_SHA}.tar.gz --only-show-errors
aws s3 cp "s3://${AWS_RELEASES_BUCKET}/releases/${RELEASE_SHA}/site.tar.gz.sha256" release-artifact/<site-project>-site-${RELEASE_SHA}.tar.gz.sha256 --only-show-errors
(
  cd release-artifact
  checksum_file="<site-project>-site-${RELEASE_SHA}.tar.gz.sha256"
  expected_archive="<site-project>-site-${RELEASE_SHA}.tar.gz"
  # Validate: exactly one LF-terminated line, no CRLF
  test "$(wc -l < "$checksum_file")" -eq 1
  ! grep -q $'\r' "$checksum_file"
  # Read and validate line format
  IFS= read -r line < "$checksum_file"
  # Verify: 64-hex digest, two spaces, exact basename
  if ! printf '%s' "$line" | grep -Eq '^[a-f0-9]{64}  <site-project>-site-[a-f0-9]{40}\.tar\.gz$'; then
    echo "::error::Checksum file has invalid format"
    exit 1
  fi
  # Verify basename SHA matches RELEASE_SHA
  file_sha=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed 's/^[a-f0-9]\{64\}  <site-project>-site-//;s/\.tar\.gz$//')
  if [ "$file_sha" != "$RELEASE_SHA" ]; then
    echo "::error::Checksum basename SHA does not match release SHA"
    exit 1
  fi
  # Verify and extract
  shasum -a 256 -c "$checksum_file"
  tar -xzf "$expected_archive" -C release
)
